findings.message: FK (unnamed) uses ON DELETE CASCADE - deleting a parent row in customer silently deletes child rows.
findings.recommendation: Confirm this is intended; index the FK column to avoid full scans on parent delete.

findings.message: CREATE OR REPLACE fn_touch_created without baseline - rollback defaults to DROP.
findings.recommendation: Provide the current source if it already exists.

findings.message: Row-level trigger adds per-row overhead to all INSERT on customer (bulk loads/batch jobs slow down).
findings.recommendation: Benchmark batch jobs; consider disabling during bulk loads.

findings.message: CREATE OR REPLACE active_customer_v: without a baseline the agent cannot tell whether a previous version exists. Rollback defaults to DROP VIEW.
findings.recommendation: If the view exists today, supply its DDL via --baseline so rollback restores it.

findings.message: FK (unnamed) on APP.CUSTOMER_ORDER (customer_id) has no supporting index - parent DELETE/UPDATE does full scans and (Oracle) locks the child table.
Unnamed PRIMARY KEY on customer - database generates a different SYS_ name in every environment (rollback/diff cannot reference it).
Unnamed PRIMARY KEY on customer_order - database generates a different SYS_ name in every environment (rollback/diff cannot reference it).
Unnamed FOREIGN KEY on customer_order - database generates a different SYS_ name in every environment (rollback/diff cannot reference it).
Row locks held on app.customer until COMMIT; long-running DML blocks OLTP.
findings.recommendation: Keep DML in its own changeSet; size undo; run off-peak.
For environment independence use a changelog property, e.g. <property name="schema" value="APP"/> and ${schema}.OBJECT, or rely on the connection's default schema (liquibase.defaultSchemaName).
